title: Law360 covers Burford’s Korea hire as part of broader growth strategy
summary: Law360 reports on Burford's appointment of Elizabeth Shin as Senior Vice President and Head of Korea, situating the hire within the firm’s wider push to expand its geographic footprint. The article highlights Shin’s focus on capital-intensive, cross-border disputes involving Korean companies, and includes commentary from Managing Director of Burford Asia Quentin Pak on the growing use of legal finance as a strategic tool for managing complex litigation risk. Learn more.
body_markdown:
**Law360** reports on Burford's appointment of[Elizabeth Shin](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/elizabeth-shin/) as Senior Vice President and Head of Korea, situating the hire within the firm’s wider push to expand its geographic footprint. The article highlights Shin’s focus on capital-intensive, cross-border disputes involving Korean companies, and includes commentary from Managing Director of Burford Asia[Quentin Pak](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/quentin-pak/) on the growing use of legal finance as a strategic tool for managing complex litigation risk.


Read the article[here](https://www.law360.com/articles/2432220/burford-capital-hires-new-korea-exec-amid-growth-push) .
